messages:
Sahil S: Hi folks! Im Sahil, joined Platform (infra) today from Pune. Mostly remote, evenings IST. Big into late-night samosas and ambient synth playlists. Super excited to dive in :wave:
Jordan H: Welcome Sahil! :tada: Pune represent. Which area?
Sahil S: Viman Nagar. small room, bigger plant collection (working on the snake plant).
Priya N: Yay! We do an optional "sync for night owls" every Thursday at 10pm IST. Totally informal.
Lena Q: Quick hardware FYI: I sent the laptop preference form — if you prefer a USB-C dock shout now before procurement runs.
Sahil S: Thanks Lena, sent the form. Would love a dock. Also stickers? I collect OS-themed stickers.
Nate M: Sticker vote: reply with :rocket: for performance stickers or :cat: for silly stickers.
Priya N: :cat: all the way.
Jordan H: :rocket: for me. Performance badge gang.
SupportBot: Sahil S, your Okta and Google Workspace accounts are active. Laptop order placed (ETA 3-5 business days).
Sahil S: Awesome, thanks! Also curious about meme culture here  any pinned meme channels or is #random the safe bet?
Lena Q: #random is the kitchen sink. occasionally #design posts top-tier stickers.
Priya N: Also FYI: monthly virtual coffee roulette is next Wednesday. DM me if you want me to pair you with someone on infra.
Sahil S: Would love that. Also if anyone has vim remap tips or a dotfiles repo, please throw it my way.
Jordan H: DM incoming with dotfiles + snippet to remap Caps to Escape.
Nate M: Welcome again Sahil! :thumbsup: Looking forward to seeing you on the infra board.
Sahil S: Thanks all! Appreciate the warm welcome. Looking forward to late-night deploys and many samosas. :smile:
